description:
Get all associations of a specific type for an object.

Useful for pivoting between object types in either direction, e.g.:
- deal -> contacts / companies / line_items
- line_item -> deals (resolves a line item back to its parent deal)
- ticket -> contacts / companies
- contact -> deals / companies

RETURNS: { results: [{ id, type }] } — array of associated record IDs.

fromObjectType.description: Source object type. Common values: "contacts", "companies", "deals", "tickets", "leads", "products", "line_items", or any custom object name.

toObjectType.description: Target object type. Common values: "contacts", "companies", "deals", "tickets", "leads", "products", "line_items", or any custom object name.

name: get_hubspot_associations
